name: scatter_japanese
description: Japanese consonants as a scatter overlay on the vocal tract. Same 7-column IPA-compact frame as scatter_english.json for cross-language comparison: glottal, velar, palatal/post-alveolar, alveolar, dental, labio-dental, bilabial (back→front). 10 rows × 0.1in delta_r centered at r=2.5. ~16 cells. Japanese's narrow consonant inventory shows as a sparse cloud — no labio-dental, no dental fricatives, no plain voiced fricatives.
